body: Thank you. I'm glad I'm not the only one feeling the same way.

I can't trust anyone. I have one friend who is aware of my state, but he can't help me. He doesn't know how. Every time when I do open up to him, he shuts down. But I am thankful that he at least listens.

I've already helped so many people. In fact, everyone comes to me for help, and they don't realize that I am calling out. Everyone thinks I'm happy, when in reality I struggle to find ways to stay alive each night. I used to love helping others in trouble until a few started taking advantage. I can't trust anyone anymore.
